bars.says: On an inhabited Miasma map the player recognises a stilt-root forest in brackish channels, reads fresh mud and sea-side salt, and sees benign rainbow plants through the green-gold haze.

meant.intent: a readable place to settle with usable passages and construction ground
meant.source: design/Jawa/worldbuilding/biomes/the_miasma.md sections 1, 3 and 9, September 7 ratified sheet. September 23 flora roster gives the distinct benign blooms. Delegated from those descriptions for the ordinary colony-view contrast.

figurative.stands_for: Benign plants collectively show saturated blooms in several colours.
figurative.accept: A patch of single-colour blooms and a nearby patch of a different saturated colour are both distinguishable through the haze.

accept: From a working settlement, prop-root cages and low crowns enclose channels, pale salt banks mark the seaward side and saturated blooms remain distinguishable through warm haze. Workers can reach the fresh buildable patches.
After recession, older dead ilbareen stand beyond the current water margin while the current water colours still reveal where brine is now.
reject: A generic green forest covers blue ponds under a green filter, with root forms and salt banks indistinguishable at colony zoom.
A legible showcase corner sits beside the base while the ordinary inhabited map is an impassable wall of roots or loses its blooms in opaque haze.
bars.lazy: none: Recognition includes the actual canopy, channels, fresh/salt contrast, benign blooms and simultaneous haze in inhabited regions. A generic tinted forest omits named visible content.

meant.intent: ordinary renewable life that can feed and reward a settlement
meant.source: September 23 Miasma fauna and flora roster rulings, standing flyers-fly and native-drinking rulings, admitted roster in RM_Miasma.xml. Delegated for the sustainable ordinary-harvest interpretation.

accept: A hunter takes edible scuttlers, animal predators feed, a plant visibly feeds on an eligible wild scuttler, and later ordinary life replenishes the worked channel.
The keeper obtains liliana silk and eggs and karrobel castings through ordinary jobs while a swarm’s flight tracker enters flight and a native beside its own water drinks successfully.
A colonist, a tame scuttler and a rainbow bloom share the worked patch safely while the separate carnivorous plant takes wild prey.
reject: Scuttlers are painted or spawned for a showcase and disappear from routine channels after ordinary hunting and predation.
The plant kills a colonist, a tame animal or prey behind a sealed wall, or silently deletes the prey with no feeding sign.
Products exist in defs but ordinary harvest/husbandry cannot obtain them, or a fictional flyer only walks on the ground.
bars.lazy: none: The sentence requires obtainable ordinary products, actual replenishing prey and both consumers, benign blooms and actual flight. Static roster entries or a one-time spawn grant omit those actions.

meant.intent: a changing shore the colony must plan around

figurative.stands_for: the extent of water and salt influence on the local colony map
figurative.accept: Brine spreads around irregular banks and roots in a broken front with several channel branches. It need not form a straight line.

accept: The weather and warning change, a worker returns from a nearby channel job, brine wets a previously exposed margin and the fresh crop patch it reaches fails while constructed surfaces remain usable.
The new water withdraws from that margin into disconnected low spots, and removing a bridge later reveals the correctly updated natural ground beneath it.
reject: A warning and water recolour occur on a permanently fixed water footprint, so recession cannot create a newly isolated pool.
The front instantly traps a worker after its first sign, or it replaces the player’s completed floor with raw crust.
The tide repeats on a fixed calendar while the sky stays clear, or all brine advance fails to affect exposed crops.
bars.lazy: none: Storm timing, changed channel extent, unfloored salt consequences, worker withdrawal and intact construction are all explicit. A recolour, instant trap or overwritten floor loses a named consequence.

bars.says: On Miasma, a mother sometimes arrives with her own stranded young and receding surge water is the recurring cause of occupied cut-off pools, with identifiable young in either case calling for help, rescuable before drying and leaving a readable outcome if help fails.

meant.intent: a readable nursery rescue available on arrival and recurring through surge withdrawal
meant.source: Frozen sheet nursery and stranded rings, September 23 fauna roster §6 mother-and-young arrival and stranded-condition rulings, closed MIASMA_YOUNG_CALL_1, and standing no-unreadable-vanish ruling. Delegated for rescue effort range and saved individual tracking.

accept: A formerly sea-connected branch becomes a shrinking pool after recession, an existing juvenile is visibly stranded and a prepared party returns it before the pool dries.
A rescued young remains identifiable after its former pool expires, while a delayed wild young dies visibly or has its departure explicitly reported at that pool.
The call remains locatable during an unresolved carry and stops when that individual’s rescue is accepted.
A mother placed with the map arrives with her own stranded young nearby, whose call leads to a rescue or a decision to hold it for sale before any storm.
reject: A proof helper spawns a young in a painted pond, and neither the mother’s arrival nor a surge caused it.
The pool expiry destroys a rescued colony animal elsewhere on the map, or only a developer log reveals the missing animal.
The first call opens a letter but the animal is silent and unlocatable through the actual rescue, or all ordinary rescues time out before a ready party can arrive.
bars.lazy: none: Natural mother placement can supply her own stranded young, and recurring surge rescues require real cut-off pools. Both routes require locatable young and readable outcomes. Helper-spawned young, replacement pawns and silent expiry cannot meet it.

A child follows its keeper along the water and stops when the keeper goes inland.
After a canal is cut the mother stays visibly in the wet isolated component, and restoring the water route makes it usable again.
reject: A valid water destination causes a path across a dry shortcut, followed by a periodic teleport or recovery walk.
A fresh river exit or any large closed pond is treated as a sea connection, or an isolated-pool flag deletes the trapped mother.
A trained child offers general land hauling and repeatedly starts impossible jobs, or a canal grants command of the wild mother.
bars.lazy: none: The sentence covers executed movement and work in water, sea-connected entry and visible severance. Water destinations followed by dry shortcuts or an arbitrary large pond omit a named constraint.

bars.says: Returning a stranded young to its own Miasma mother’s reachable water earns colony-wide tolerance except for colonists harvesting anything within her anchor reach, whom she targets at once, while completing the sale of a young held for trade permanently costs that nursery’s tolerance and inheritance.

meant.intent: the nursery choice having a durable and local consequence
meant.source: September 23 befriending ruling and closed MIASMA_MOTHERS_PRICE_1 for the October 2 owner card. Delegated for completed-transaction commit and durable known parentage. Frozen the_miasma.md section 4 and September 23 fauna section 6 explicitly retain targeting for harvesting anything inside her reach.

accept: A carried or canal-freed young reaches its own mother’s accessible water, distress ends and she stops targeting non-harvesting colonists while remaining wild.

A colonist carries a wild stranded young to wet custody with Hold for trade, and the same still-distressed young appears in an ordinary eligible trader’s dialog. The completed sale transfers that young for payment, and its nursery permanently refuses later forgiveness while an unrelated nursery can still accept its own young.
Cancelling a sale leaves both the child and the nursery’s standing intact, and harming the nursery later ends previously earned tolerance.
A tolerated colonist cutting wood inside her reachable anchor waters is attacked while a colonist harvesting outside her anchor reach works unharmed by her.
reject: Any nearby mother accepts any child and awards colony-wide protection, or the return removes the only identity record needed for later consent.
Opening a trade window or an unaffordable offer voids succession before a sale completes.
A success letter appears while the mother still targets non-harvesting tolerated colonists, or a reload or setting cycle forgives a completed betrayal.
A tolerated colonist harvests salt beside the crèche untouched because only harming nursery young can trigger the mother’s defence.
bars.lazy: none: Actual colony-wide target exclusion, its explicit any-harvest exception within anchor reach, correct parentage and permanent completed-sale consequences rule out unconditional protection, wrong-parent credit and merely attempted trades.

Actual completed/cancelled/rejected/unfunded trade with ordinary traders and unavailable trader factions. Harvest wood/plants/salt/animals just inside, at and outside the actual anchor boundary; reachable water-side versus inaccessible positions; start/stop/cancel harvest with and without tolerance, concurrent non-harvesting colonists, save during a harvest. Separate temporary any-harvest targeting from nursery-member harm and permanent completed-sale betrayal.

bars.says: In a clean-record Miasma nursery, young frequently choose the colony and do useful water-bound work, and after the mother’s foreshadowed old-age death during colony life a self-tamed juvenile of that nursery can inherit a weaker watch against hostiles in its reduced water reach, letting colony harvesters work unharmed, if the colony has successfully rescued young there.

meant.intent: hopeful continuity with an earned, visibly weaker successor
meant.source: September 23 fauna roster section 6a for self-taming, useful water work, foreshadowed old-age death and juvenile succession. Later fluff digest explicitly retains succession. Delegated for persistence, old-save reconciliation and single promotion semantics.

figurative.stands_for: At a clean nursery with living young, at least one young usually chooses the colony before the mother dies across independent ordinary histories.
figurative.accept: After natural maternal deaths, most clean nursery histories with living young show that a young chose the colony. Some finish without a consenting young, and successful choices have no regular schedule.

accept: The mother is visibly failing from first encounter and the keeper receives a plain age warning. In the usual clean nursery history with living young, a juvenile chooses the colony before the mother dies and does real Guard or release/attack work along the water.
After the anticipated age-related loss a living eligible juvenile actually guards that nursery with less reach and threat than the mother, and the saved watch continues after reload.
An empty or betrayed nursery remains without an heir and tells the player why.

A self-tamed sibling that was never rescued takes the weaker watch because the colony successfully returned another young to that same clean nursery; an otherwise identical nursery with no rescue has no heir.
After inheritance, a colonist gathering salt beside the crèche works unharmed while the heir attacks a hostile raider crossing its channel.
reject: A saved heir name and celebratory message appear while no juvenile takes guard duty.
The mother never declines within colony play, dies without prior warning, or her child instantly becomes an equal adult sea giant.
A returned child loses its nursery link and can never consent or inherit, or a killed/traded young is resurrected or replaced to force succession.
A clean nursery with living young usually reaches the mother’s death without any young having chosen the colony, leaving affection a windfall even when the few consents match the model.

The colony rescued a young at this clean nursery, but its living water-connected self-tamed sibling is refused solely because that sibling was never rescued, or a different nursery’s rescue supplies the missing credit.
The heir attacks its own colony’s salt gatherer beside the inherited crèche.
bars.lazy: none: Frequent ordinary consent, executed water work and a real weaker watch earned by this nursery’s colony rescue record are explicit. Rare windfalls, individual-rescue-only eligibility and name-only promotion omit those experiences.

range.varies: All admitted free roster entries and, when the campaign layer is present, its patch-added entries, with all DLC. Fresh and older-save states. Colony sizes 1, 8 and 40. Local map sizes 150x150, 250x250 and 325x325, plus the largest supplied authored local site if larger. Boundary values and transitions are generated, not inferred from a representative screenshot. Clean/harmed/betrayed and no/multiple eligible young, normal/deformed/recovered/carried history, old and new saves with and without ledger fields, juvenile alive/downed/dead/away or sold at promotion. Test age decline, age death and unrelated violent death separately, colony harvesters and hostiles inside and outside the heir’s reduced reach, heir duty through later surge, call, canal severance and repair. Use ordinary time until the actual age cycle closes, delegated tuning target 30-60 game days from encounter with full warning already present. Alternative action orders rescue/train/canal and canal/rescue/train. Explicit eligibility branches: rescued heir; never-rescued self-tamed sibling of a successfully returned young; rescued young dead or away with a living consenting sibling; no successful rescue; rescue only at a different nursery; harmed/betrayed record. Use independent RNG histories across the full B9 observation window to distinguish frequent consent from an isolated lucky roll; chance/timing calibration is C11.
range.left_out: No guaranteed consent on a particular random roll. No adult maturation, new full-strength mother, repeat heir manufacture or general land work. Violence against the mother by the colony cannot earn a clean succession.

accept: An outdoor worker accumulates visible exposure, spends time under a roof and recovers that exposure while a genuinely diseased colonist still needs ordinary tending.

reject: Rain supplies the swamp, a clear-sky test conceals the haze cost, or a biome-specific sun immunity makes the worker safe.
The roof clears a real disease instantly, or routine dry weather permanently incapacitates the colony despite ordinary shelter and tending.
A recovered disease quietly grants a deferred boon at default settings.
bars.lazy: none: The sentence links visible health cost, roof recovery and continued ordinary work with tending through dry weather. A cosmetic haze or roof-based disease cure omits that cause and response.

bars.says: With the complete default Miasma running across a season and its nursery cycle, the colony sees recurring changed shores, recoverable life and consequential rescues through reload and reordered work, without ecological engulfment, permanent barren collapse, stalled duties or recurring errors.

meant.source: Owner’s November 16 cleansing instruction for the whole bar, combined with the frozen biome’s lived cycle. Delegated integration reading and stretch long enough for inheritance.

figurative.stands_for: Breeders or events displace ordinary play, the whole-map model’s flood.
figurative.accept: Scuttler numbers rise after a good breeding stretch while hunting, building and tending still proceed.

figurative.stands_for: Ordinary life fails to recover in the habitable fresh region, the whole-map model’s desert.
figurative.accept: A salt-crusted margin stays bare while habitable fresh patches replenish ordinary canopy and prey.

accept: A working settlement hunts, builds, tends, rescues and trades through repeated natural storm advances and recessions, saves during an unresolved pool and resumes with the same animals, history and viable routes.

Over the full stretch, harvested channels regain ordinary life, warnings lead to actions, betrayal remains local and permanent, and an age-related loss either transfers a real smaller watch or leaves a plainly explained empty nursery.
A replay that builds its canal before rescuing and a replay that rescues before finishing its canal each reaches coherent recorded outcomes with the rest of colony work still functioning.
reject: Isolated demonstration scenes pass while the running map fills with breeders, loses its ordinary canopy to accumulated crust, or produces an endless queue of rescue warnings.
Reload revives an expired pool, forgets a sale, erases a saved child or breaks the relationship between a mother and her nursery.
The mother spends the season restarting call jobs, the child repeatedly fails land hauling, or errors recur while a laboratory scene succeeds with weather and growth disabled.
bars.lazy: none: The complete default system must run the season and nursery cycle, maintain actual rescue consequences and ecological/work continuity, and survive reload and reordered actions. Isolated scenes leave explicit requirements unobserved.

Settings initialisers, persistence, reset/search/scope labels and Apply paths match shipped defaults. Test queued old bills, running jobs, existing map objects and older-save missing fields through off/on/reload. Include lastvineRearingEnabled previously omitted by validation.DEFAULTS.
Snapshot salinity thresholds, front/recede/residual controls, pool weights, lifetime/threshold/edge rules and terrain under/top/foundation writes as regression data. Tune without changing B3/B4.
Snapshot ordinary plant yields/growth, animal diets/products, density/pressure values and product stack conservation. Neither numbers nor field-completeness are passing bars.
Record each model calibration residual, inputs, map/runtime fingerprint and exact game event trace. A model without agreement is untrusted.

Existing kernel fuzz and mutation checks for nearest selection, trust, ordinary trade outcomes, refusal quieting and no duplicate committed transitions. Add real transaction/callback seams and preserve parentage across distress removal.
No default grant of fever-forged or strange hediffs, growth aura or inspiration, including after natural disease removal. No pollination gate restored. Haze exposure is independently active.

No default custom nursery-buyer incident, decay meter/research availability, cell construction/feed/conversion, corpse processing or Cuisine output, attar production/application, loose flotsam seeding/deposits or dedicated juvenile water-side hauling. Existing code/defs remain stable and inert. Read game availability and active state, not DefDatabase absence.
Full executed path traces, sea-source and hydrological components, movement-surface eligibility and actual guard anchor/duty. Include bridge, cut/repair and dry-shortcut mutants.
Pool references never remove rescued/traded/out-of-pool animals at expiry. Sound source/first warning and loss notice name real individuals. No duplicate warning on polling/reload.

Existing warden age texture/render-state tests and negative verdict mutants. Record actual initial age, health decline, death cause, known warning time and smaller heir defence footprint. No graphic count as a bar. Record consent chance, eligible roll cadence, opportunity totals and outcomes across independent histories over B9’s window; use chance and cadence to calibrate the model and tune probability. B7 frequency is classified from ordinary game histories.
Native water need recovery by each admitted targeting path, deterministic real flight state for fictional flyers, and identical Direct Sun output at equal geometry across biomes.
No live whole-run helper directly sets success, disables a kept mechanic, locks sky clear or freezes incident/life clocks. Chronological event and RNG/save manifests support same-start replay.

rules.rule: Use fixed authored local-site geography and a declared seaward boundary. No world tile, planet generation, river-link repair, rarity option or alternate-planet sweep. Sites without a sea boundary report missing local input. The held mod remains design-only.

The surge contract includes temporary wetting and recession capable of changing water connectivity. Salinity and residual crust may persist, but repeated allowed surges must leave habitable fresh ground and recoverable native life. Keep normal incident/weather clocks irregular and storm-weighted. Derive a reversible inundation mask from local geography using the existing shared-engine seam, its owner chooses internals.

Apply natural terrain changes beneath floors/bridges, preserving their constructed top and foundation state. Bare gravship foundations are preserved. Unfloored salt-sensitive crops and ilbareen in newly reached brine fail, leaving readable signs. Historical dead ilbareen record past reach, current water/soil records present salt.

Use the shared fluid connectivity representation with explicit seaward sources and orthogonal contact. A freshwater edge, diagonal touch or area threshold alone never proves sea connection. Movement also requires an executable water-only route on the movement plane. A bridge preserves its underlying fluid connection but can obstruct a swimmer’s movement surface. Existing trapped animals may move inside their wet component, receive distress and drying outcomes, and regain outside routes after repair. No new entry into isolated water is permitted.

Assign a young’s nursery once from its spawn site and persist identity separately from the distress hediff. Returning clears distress, preserves the known child and records return once. Reconnection retires pool tracking without destroying occupants. Pool expiry excludes returned, owned, sold, departed or out-of-pool animals and gives unresolved loss a player-visible sign. Honour the permitted fallback without granting rescue credit.

Only the child’s own reachable mother accepts return. Completing Hold for trade delivers a carried, unresolved wild young to a chosen reachable wet holding cell outside its mother’s acceptance water and makes it colony-held in the player faction without taming or granting training. Keep distress and nursery identity. Only an unresolved custody-held young is listed for this sale branch with an ordinary eligible trader. Interrupted delivery leaves the young unheld. Accepting a return ends custody and restores wild status if custody was the sole basis of colony ownership. Commit payment/ownership and permanent betrayal atomically after completed trade. Cancel/refusal cannot betray. Colony pawn, turret and harvest/butchery harm to nursery members breaks the clean record and revokes tolerance. Unrelated disease or wildlife harm does not. Betrayal survives reload and toggle. Group notifications by nursery and changed reason. Evaluate a legitimate offered return before routine maternal acquisition of that carrier as a target at the acceptance water, so the normal rescue action can complete without changing the mother’s general hostility. Tolerance removes the colony from ordinary targets, but starting any harvest of plants, wood, salt or animals inside the mother’s anchor reach immediately restores that actor as a defence target, tolerated or not; outside-reach harvesting does not. This is a per-act exception, not permanent colony-wide revocation. Stopping non-nursery harvest restores ordinary exclusion if trust remains intact. Damage, killing, harvesting or butchering nursery young instead breaks the nursery’s clean record. Targeting never permits a dry-land chase or enlarges the anchor.

Keep the mother wild and anchored. Young consent is frequent and probabilistic while the affiliated record is clean, is never conventional taming, and remains possible after a genuine return. Preserve Guard and release/attack with full-route eligibility and hide general Haul/Rescue. An age-related death can promote a living eligible juvenile once, with less reach and combat threat. The colony-owned heir targets hostiles within its reduced reachable water anchor and excludes its own colony’s harvesters. The mother’s harvest exception ends with her watch. No rescue means no manufactured heir. Colony killing the mother bars a clean inheritance. Initial mother age is plainly failing, with a delegated tuning target of loss within 30-60 game days and warning already present on encounter. Use ordinary age/health progression, calibrated before choosing a final constant. Consent without rescue is allowed, but inheritance requires at least one actual successful colony rescue/return at that same nursery, its still-clean record, and a living self-tamed young affiliated to it with a legitimate local water route to the nursery; the heir need not itself have been rescued. A known away pawn waits as an absent candidate until the death decision, and cannot be replaced or teleported into the nursery. The single promotion decision at death records an absent heir if no eligible local young exists.

Plant prey selection stays on the existing wild scuttler whitelist with a genuine unobstructed feeding reach and visible kill/feeding event. Radius is a tuning check. Use shared population accounting with ordinary predators, hunting and ExplosiveGrowth active. Keep ordinary meat, wood/salt, silk/egg and castings jobs. Native drinking and real fictional flight remain standing obligations. Ordinary canopy recruitment respects current fresh/brackish/brine bands, with ilbareen fresh, brelloch brine, thessamor brackish and quennath fresh/brackish as delegated initial defaults. Do not teleport established life when bands move. Specialist host/castings/pollination gates remain deferred.

Surge weather overrides the standing haze during advance and returns to it after recession. Both remain dry and exposure uses the active weather’s declared treatment. Roofs recover haze exposure through the shared hazard path. Ordinary diseases stay ordinary, biome-specific Direct Sun changes are forbidden. Keep the shared geometric sun/shade rule and native water use active.

Settings default to the kept behaviour. Every major kept mechanic has an effective on/off control and accurate scope/application label. Existing shared controls expose their cross-biome scope. All-off suspends active producers and safely retains terrain, objects, identities and irreversible records. Missing older-save state is reconciled once with visible uncertainty when no historical nursery can be recovered.

All deferred and recommended-for-retirement active behaviours default off and are absent from fresh-map availability. Preserve their defs, code, assets and saved progress inertly. Keep return/consent operational independently of optional sale or succession controls. Turn off decay/cuisine, attar and boons at every actual execution and availability entry point. The retired pollination gate remains retired. Worldgen has no next-version mode. A next-version control defaults off for initial and recurring flotsam deposits and dedicated juvenile water-side hauling. Guard and release/attack operate independently.

Retain admitted rosters and present naming tiers, without eviction or new giants. Shared Wreckage, creature pressure, native growth, environmental hazards, Bones references, TerminalBiomes juveniles, FlowWorks and the standing AcousticScanner payload remain dependencies. Diagnostics are checks and instruments. A clean log or resolved def alone proves no experience.

meetings.why: Temporary inundation, floor preservation, historical crust and current water can combine to make either no new pools or cumulative barren collapse. The current repaint never wets dry cells.

The same surge, canal, pool and work graph drives isolation, calls, rescue and defence. Endpoint-only checks and any-edge heuristics cannot establish the whole invariant. Harvest defence must obey the same anchor and water path limits.

Return removes the hediff holding identity while trade callbacks and promotion can race or lose prior state. Several nurseries and an expiring pool expose the combined failure. The nursery’s colony rescue credit is independent of the heir’s individual history; per-act ordinary harvesting alters current targets without falsely marking nursery harm.
ExplosiveGrowth, salt loss, scuttler breeding, ordinary predation and colony harvest share the map over time. Pairwise good rates can still destroy the food floor or fill the map.
Standing haze and surge forcing, exposure recovery, native growth and Direct Sun must run together with their normal priorities and clocks. No all-on season trace is current.

Concurrent tending, slow travel, blocked work, several pools and trade can consume rescue windows and restart duties. Ordinary party success cannot be inferred from individual job methods. Maternal harvest defence can interrupt colony harvest and rescue work.

Every relevant transition has a named inspectable current state and bounded locatable sign. Current water and old salt gauges describe different times, distinct nursery identities keep their signs local, and roof recovery is distinguished from disease. Actual rendering and notification implementation are still owed in the named tickets.

The default kept-mechanic manifest defines every bar’s on state. Controls pause producers while stable records remain authoritative, so no successful branch relies on an enabled deferred feature. Independent return, sale and succession gates are explicitly required, and off/on/reload checks reject silent resets.
